While all individuals with MSD have neurologic impairment, the other systemic features can be variable and are often not present at birth [45,48,50]. panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Panel A shows characteristic hand dysostosis (metacarpal hypoplasia and irregularities) of multiple sulfatase deficiency, as specified in the caption. B: Panel B shows characteristic vertebral malformation (platyspondily) of multiple sulfatase deficiency, based on the visual evidence and caption. C: Panel C demonstrates lumbar skeletal involvement (hypoplasia and kyphosis) consistent with multiple sulfatase deficiency. D: Panel D shows skeletal abnormalities in the ribs (broad ribs), consistent with the pattern of dysplasia seen in multiple sulfatase deficiency.

A: Panel A shows a human patient demonstrating coarse facial features and ichthyosis, which are manifestations of multiple sulfatase deficiency. B: Panel B shows a human patient demonstrating head and neck findings (micrognathia and ear abnormalities) consistent with the phenotype of multiple sulfatase deficiency. D: Panel D shows a human patient demonstrating ichthyosiform scaling on the limbs, characteristic of multiple sulfatase deficiency.
